ladder.heading: The ladder
ladder.help: Each rung is a group with a post threshold. Members hold exactly one rung, the highest their post count has reached, and their other groups are never touched.
ladder.help_points: Each rung is a group with a points threshold. Members hold exactly one rung, the highest their points have reached, and their other groups are never touched.
ladder.empty: No rungs yet. Add the first one, usually a rank that starts at 0 posts so every member has one from the day they join.
ladder.empty_points: No rungs yet. Add the first one, usually a rank that starts at 0 points so every member has one from the day they join.
ladder.hidden_group: Hidden group. Members won't see this rung.
ladder.has_image: Has a picture on the banner
ladder.preview_help: This is drawn from the ladder above and shown at the top of the Ranks page. Give a rank a picture to use it in place of the icon.

metric.label: Rank members by
metric.help: Posts counts every reply and discussion a member writes.
metric.help_points: Leaderboard points use the totals from the Leaderboard extension, so likes, reactions, best answers and anything else it scores all count.
metric.help_votes: Gamification points are the upvotes and downvotes a member's posts have received, from FoF Gamification. Ranks change the moment a vote is cast.
metric.points_note: A member's rank is checked against their points whenever they use the forum, at most every two minutes, so it follows points they earn while away, such as likes on their posts.
metric.switched: Now ranking by {metric}, and everyone has been re-ranked. Check the thresholds below still make sense for it.

rerank.help: Puts every member on the rung their post count has earned. Runs on its own after you change the ladder; use this after changing the settings below.
rerank.help_points: Puts every member on the rung their points have earned. Runs on its own after you change the ladder; use it too after Leaderboard recalculates its totals.
rerank.finished: Done. {changed, plural, =0 {Everyone was already on the right rung.} one {# member changed rank.} other {# members changed rank.}}
rerank.failed: Re-ranking stopped partway, so some members may be on the wrong rung. Run it again to finish.

modal.source_new: Create a new group for this rung
modal.source_existing: Use a group I already have
modal.existing_help: The group's members stay in it. Ladder only adds and removes members as they climb.
modal.plural_help: Used where Flarum lists the group's members. Leave empty to use the rank name.
modal.min_posts_help: A member reaches this rung at this many posts, and stays on it until they reach the next one.
modal.min_posts_help_points: A member reaches this rung at this many points, and stays on it until they reach the next one.
modal.icon_help: A Font Awesome class, e.g. fas fa-tv. It shows on the rank badge.
modal.description_help: Shown on the public Ranks page. Optional.
modal.image_help: Shown on this rank's card in the banner, in place of the icon. Tall pictures fit best, about 3 wide by 5 high. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 8MB.
modal.delete_confirm_owned: Remove this rung? Its group was made by Ladder, so the group is deleted too, and its members move to the rung below.
modal.delete_confirm_existing: Remove this rung? The group itself stays, members included. Ladder will just stop managing it.

settings.inherit_label: Higher ranks keep the permissions of lower ones
settings.inherit_help: Rank groups usually need no permissions, since every member already has the Member group's. To unlock something at a rank, grant it once to the lowest rank that should have it and every rank above inherits it. Members still wear one rank badge.
settings.demote_label: Move members down when they fall below their rank
settings.demote_help: Off by default, so a rank once reached is kept even if posts are deleted or points are taken away later. Turn on for a strict ranking.
settings.exempt_label: Groups that never get a rank
settings.exempt_help: Members of these groups are kept off the ladder entirely. Useful for bots and staff accounts.
settings.show_nav_label: Show a Ranks link in the forum sidebar
settings.show_nav_help: The Ranks page lists every rung and shows signed-in members how far they are from the next one. It's always at /ranks.
settings.banner_title_help: The heading across the top of the ranks banner. Leave empty to use your forum's name.
settings.banner_tagline_help: A short line under the title, e.g. your forum's motto. Optional.
settings.banner_on_index_label: Also show the banner on the home page
settings.banner_on_index_help: Puts the ranks banner above the discussion list, so every visitor sees what there is to climb.

ranks.title: Ranks
ranks.intro: Every post you make moves you up the ladder. Here's every rank, and what it takes to reach it.
ranks.intro_points: Everything that earns you points moves you up the ladder. Here's every rank, and what it takes to reach it.
ranks.empty: This forum hasn't set up any ranks yet.
ranks.your_rank: You're a {rank}, with {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}.
ranks.your_rank_points: You're a {rank}, with {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.
ranks.next: {count, plural, one {# more post} other {# more posts}} to reach {rank}.
ranks.next_points: {count, plural, one {# more point} other {# more points}} to reach {rank}.
ranks.unranked: {count, plural, one {# more post} other {# more posts}} to reach your first rank, {rank}.
ranks.unranked_points: {count, plural, one {# more point} other {# more points}} to reach your first rank, {rank}.
ranks.guest: Sign up and start posting to climb the ladder.
ranks.exempt: Your group is kept off the ladder, so you don't hold a rank.

profile.heading: Rank
profile.next: {count, plural, one {# more post} other {# more posts}} until {name} reaches {rank}.
profile.next_points: {count, plural, one {# more point} other {# more points}} until {name} reaches {rank}.
profile.next_own: {count, plural, one {# more post} other {# more posts}} to reach {rank}.
profile.next_own_points: {count, plural, one {# more point} other {# more points}} to reach {rank}.

errors.min_posts_invalid: Posts needed must be a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.min_posts_taken: Another rung already starts at {count} posts. Each rung needs its own threshold.
errors.min_points_invalid: Points needed must be a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.min_points_taken: Another rung already starts at {count} points. Each rung needs its own threshold.
errors.name_invalid: Give the rank a name, up to 100 characters.
errors.color_invalid: The colour must be a hex value, e.g. #7c3aed.
errors.group_invalid: That group can't be used as a rank.
errors.group_taken: That group is already a rung on the ladder.
errors.image_type: That file isn't a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF picture.
